page.overview:
Who is Nodens?

Nodens (also known as Lord of the Great Abyss) is a healing god from Celtic mythology, incorporated into the Cthulhu Mythos by H. P. Lovecraft's short story "The Strange High House in the Mist". The character is generally depicted as being an inhabitant of the Dreamlands and the master of the night-gaunts, a servitor race of flying creatures.

Later writers, starting with August Derleth, refer to Nodens as an Elder God. (: "A Note on the Cthulhu Mythos") Lin Carter suggested that Nodens is likely the leader of the Elder Gods (it is considered to be either Nodens or Kthanid). (: "The Necronomicon: The Dee Translation")

Nodens is an "archaic" god served by the night-gaunts. He seems to be somewhat benevolent, opposing the frightening Nyarlathotep, and helping Randolph Carter to find his way back to the waking world, along with S'ngac. (: The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath)

Nodens is also described with "...the grey and awful form of primal Nodens, Lord of the Great Abyss". He appeared to Thomas Olney and the One, along with the ocean god Neptune and a procession of tritons and nereids. Nodens was riding a "vast crenulate shell" carried by dolphins. He extended a hand to help Olney and the One board the shell carriage and took off "into the limitless aether". (: "The Strange High House in the Mist")
